categories_thin: Land surveying: only out-of-zone surveyors found (Piscataway, East Brunswick, Hillsborough, North Brunswick). No land surveyor with a Franklin Township address surfaced.
Real estate appraisal: appraisal firms returned were in Piscataway, Edison, Warren and Kendall Park; no in-zone appraisal office found.
Architecture: only two in-zone architecture practices surfaced; several architect results were New Brunswick, North Brunswick or Milltown addresses.
Title agencies: most title companies near 08873 sit on Route 18 / Stelton Rd (East Brunswick, Piscataway) or Livingston Ave (New Brunswick) - outside the zone. Only two in-zone title agencies found.

Franklin Park (08823): most professional offices on the Route 27 / Finnegans Lane corridor there reverse-geocode to North Brunswick or Kendall Park, so this half of the township contributes almost nothing to group A.
caveats: Zone = Franklin Township, Somerset County only (Somerset, Franklin Park, East Millstone, Griggstown, Middlebush, Blackwells Mills, Weston, Six Mile Run). Businesses returned by search but located in New Brunswick, North Brunswick, Milltown, East Brunswick, Piscataway, Highland Park, Kendall Park or Hillsborough were excluded after checking each address against OpenStreetMap municipal boundaries.
Google Maps in the browser returned a 'limited view' capped at 10 results per query, so coverage was built from many keyword variants per category rather than by paging a single list.

Several Route 27 addresses near the New Brunswick city line (607 and 619 NJ-27 - Premier Insurance Somerset, All in insurance, Trusted Insurance NJ) reverse-geocode to New Brunswick 08901 and were excluded. If the township line is drawn differently, those three belong on the list.

Confirmed out-of-zone and therefore excluded despite appearing in Franklin-area searches: Law Office of Megha K. Patel (1549 Finnegans Ln), Menz & Luxenberg (3176 Route 27), Narula Financial Group (1463 Finnegans Ln), Zenith Agency (918 Livingston Ave), Paragon Staffing (354 Seaman St), Insured Title Services and Brunswick Title (Livingston Ave), I&R Computer (Drift St), Sheffmaker Architecture (Redmond St), DIG Architecture (Bethany St), MDM Architecture (Hermann Rd), Lozito Law (Georges Rd), Control Layouts (Cleveland Ave), J T Surveying (Tally Ho Trail), TeamLogic IT and Staffing Alternatives (US-130), Kipcon (Livingston Ave, North Brunswick).

Branded franchise/chain offices were excluded per the brief: RE/MAX Our Town, State Farm agent offices (Tony Ventresca, Hemant Jiwnani), Real Property Management All-Star. National or multi-office B2B firms (Terracon, GZA, LaBella, Roux, Whitman, D&B, GTA, ProLogistix, PROMAN) were kept but flagged in notes so analysts can drop them.
Phone numbers and addresses come from map listings or the business's own site; several small offices publish only a suite or a PO-style address.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, Manta, BBB, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce.com, Superpages and the SCBP chamber directory all blocked automated access (HTTP 403 / Cloudflare), so bulk-directory cross-checking was not possible; only search-result snippets from those sites were usable.
Overpass API was not reachable from this environment; township membership was instead verified with Nominatim reverse geocoding of each listing's coordinates.
Website URLs are blank for most entries because Google Maps exposed a 'Website' button without a readable URL for them; the triage team should resolve those.

Sole-practitioner and home-based professional offices (individual CPAs, attorneys, consultants, insurance producers) are systematically under-represented in map data and business directories; expect more small offices than listed.
No municipal licensed-business list was accessible: Franklin Township's site does not publish a searchable professional-services directory that could be crawled.
